scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,dashboard "npm run dev -w @instagram-agent/api" "npm run dev -w @instagram-agent/dashboard"
scripts.prebuild: npm run build -w @instagram-agent/contracts && npm run build -w @instagram-agent/agent-core && npm run build -w @instagram-agent/comment-analysis && npm run build -w @instagram-agent/playwright-adapter && npm run build -w @instagram-agent/mcp-client && npm run build -w @instagram-agent/mongodb-adapter && npm run build -w @instagram-agent/ollama-adapter
scripts.typecheck: npm run prebuild && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run security:scan && npm run build
scripts.verify:release: npm run check && npm run test:coverage && node scripts/release-readiness.mjs
